raw_description:
A horizontal cartographic scale bar — alternating filled and empty
segments with small tick marks beneath, labels reading "0  ·  1  ·  2  ·  3
hexes" in small-caps serif.
formatted_prompt: Editorial field-journal ink-and-watercolor on aged vellum parchment, wide horizontal composition with generous negative space above and below. A cartographic scale bar centered on warm vellum ground — alternating solid and hollow rectangular segments in slate-grey ink, each segment separated by fine nib-pen tick marks descending below the bar's baseline. Small-caps serif numerals label each division reading zero through three, the word "hexes" closing the sequence, lettered in muted charcoal with the quiet authority of a 19th-century survey plate. Muted amber-ochre wash touches the filled segments; unfilled segments hold bare parchment. Faint foxing at the composition edges, subtle paper grain throughout. No glow, no digital finish — pure ink rule and watercolor, archival register.
